name: short-url-cfworker
description: A self-hosted URL shortener on Cloudflare Workers + D1, with an admin page.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run --bail=1 --reporter=dot --testTimeout=10000

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin page at `/admin`. Use a long, random string.

HOME_URL.description: Optional. Where to send visitors who open the bare domain. Leave empty to show a simple page.

DB.description: D1 database that stores your links. A new one is created for you.
